player_prompt.intro:
Nang tsaw ra Player {player_id} ni Chopsticks hta. Na akyu hta, lakap kaba:
  + Phan:  '[attack M O]'  M=na lakap (0 amyu 1), O=kyip lakap (0 amyu 1).
    - Kyip lakap shi akyu hta na lakap akyu hku byin; shi >=5, 0 byin.
  + Hkrat:   '[split L R]'  na akyu hku hpe L akap R (L+R = na akyu hku) hta shalawt.
Kaba hta na kaw nna shalawt.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Ninghkap ai lata {opp_idx} gaw si mat sai.
invalid_move.split_sum: Daw lahkawng garan yang sum gaw {total} rai ra ai.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Split gaw na a lata hpe galai kau ra ai.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Kaba shalawt si. '[attack M O]' amyu '[split L R]' hta shalawt.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} P{opp_id} lakap {opp_idx} phan: {opp_val} hta {new_val} byin.

outcome.win: Hkap gasat ai wa a lata lahkawng yan si mat sai.
outcome.draw: Hpang jahtum na matu, dai hpe galaw u.
